nodes.label: Rule 1: Never Put High-Volume Geometry in React Tree
nodes.rationale: Virtual DOM diffing of InstancedMesh and BufferGeometry on the main thread causes massive 30ms+ frame drops. Must use a native Three.js pipeline (ChunkRenderer.jsx) driven imperatively via useFrame.

nodes.label: Rule 2: Off-Thread All Terrain & RLE Math
nodes.rationale: Iterating over binary chunks and doing RLE decompression on the main thread pauses the browser. Offload heavy math and DB operations to dbWorker.js.

nodes.label: Rule 3: Zero-Copy Transferable Objects
nodes.rationale: Transfer raw geometry arrays (Uint32Array, Float32Array) via Transferable Objects in postMessage to avoid copy allocation spikes and detached buffer errors.

nodes.label: Rule 4: React is for Hitboxes, Native is for Visuals
nodes.rationale: ChunkPhysics.jsx mounts invisible TrimeshColliders in Rapier. Keep visuals separate from physics. Rapier compiles WebAssembly optimizations.
